sentences.text: Shri Sanjay Kumar Bahirani, learned counsel for the  petitioners.
Shri Vivek Bhargava, learned Public Prosecutor for th  respondent/State.

The present petition under Section 482 of Cr.P.C. has been preferred by the petitioners for quashment of the FIR registered in Crime No.174/2018 at Police Station Dimni, District Morena for the offences under Sections 55, 56, 57, 59, 60 & 63 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.

It is the submissions of the petitioners that without resorting to the proceeding of provisions of Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006, respondents have caused arbitrariness and illegality in registering the case against the petitioner.
He referred the judgment pronounced by different High Courts and to submit that the offence under Section 420 of the IPC is not made out.
Issue notice to the respondents on payment of process fee within seven working days through registered A.D. as well as ordinary mode, returnable within eight weeks.
Meanwhile, investigation may proceed in accordance with law.

(Anand Pathak) Judge Rashid RASHID KHAN 2018.11.27 17:52:20 +05'30'
